verdict.detail: The installed metastable liquid-table generator freezes rows after a bulk-modulus-ratio test. The generated table returns approximately room-temperature liquid at the published hot-liquid enthalpies. The current model rejects these copied stencils. No clipping, replacement EOS or weakened admissibility test was used. A valid flashing-water reproduction requires repairing and independently validating property generation first.
